name: The Board's Seat
description: The syndicate has a seat on the board of a Wall Street firm, and the penthouse vault holds the twelfth password. Start in the subway, climb out to the street and the rooftops, then go up the firm's tower and drop into the penthouse through the skylight. The soldier shoots his way down the platform, over the roofs, through the penthouse hall and along the vault floor. The hacker takes the track bed, the street, the air duct and the gantry, switching off the third rail, the lasers and the security doors, and wearing the briefcase past the turrets.
